clock_dir_past: անց ("past") counts UP from the named hour, which is the CURRENT hour:
"ութ անց կես" is 08:30.  ու ("and") fills the same slot in the standard
modern phrasing "ժամը վեցն ու կեսն է" (06:30).  Source: en.wiktionary.org,
անց (postposition, worked example "ութ անց կես" -- half past eight).
clock_fraction_15: A quarter of an hour, taking its direction from անց.
Source: en.wiktionary.org, քառորդ (the fractional of չորս).
clock_fraction_30: The spoken half hour names the hour already reached: "ութ անց կես" is
08:30, not 07:30.  կեսն is the same word with the definite article, the
form the "ու կես" phrasing uses.  Source: en.wiktionary.org, կես

marker_and: Coordinating "and".  Sources: en.wiktionary.org, ու; the conjunction և
as used in the worked example "Քո և նրա միջև".
marker_at: ժամը, literally "the hour", opens a spoken clock time ("ժամը քանի՞սն է"
-- what time is it?).  Source: en.wiktionary.org, ժամ.
marker_every: ամեն ("every", "each"), prenominal, no case suffix on the noun.
Source: en.wiktionary.org, օր ("ամեն օր" -- every day) and շաբաթ
marker_future: Armenian marks the forward offset three ways, all postposed.  ից is the
ablative case suffix on the unit noun itself ("{0} օրից" -- in N days),
split off the fused surface by the locale's number fold.  անց and հետո are
free-standing postpositions after a bare duration.  Sources:
relativeTime-type-future (ից) and relativeTime-type-future for the weekday
marker_last: relative-type--1 ("նախորդ շաբաթ" -- last week).  անցյալ and անցած are the
two adjectival synonyms en.wiktionary.org attests in the same slot
("անցյալ ձմեռ" at անցյալ, "անցած ամիս" at ամիս).
marker_minute_word: The optional "րոպե" between a minute count and the clock direction.
marker_next: relative-type-1 for day/week/month/year and the weekday fields
("հաջորդ շաբաթ" -- next week).  Prenominal, no case suffix on the noun.
marker_past: առաջ ("ago", "before") is a POSTPOSITION: it follows the phrase it
governs.  With a bare duration the counted noun is unmarked -- "{0} օր
առաջ" (N days ago).  Sources: # Unicode CLDR 47, locale hy (cldr-json cldr-dates-full/main/hy/dateFields.json).
relativeTime-type-past for every unit; en.wiktionary.org, առաջ (postposition).
marker_this: relative-type-0 ("այս շաբաթ" -- this week), corroborated by
marker_until: մինչև ("until", "up to"), a PREPOSITION -- it leads its object, unlike
առաջ/հետո.  Source: en.wiktionary.org, մինչև ("մինչև օրս" -- up to now).
marker_year_word: թ. is the standard abbreviation of թվական ("year") and TRAILS the year in
the written date ("dd MMMM, y թ.").  Source: # Unicode CLDR 47, locale hy, gregorian calendar (cldr-json
թվականի is the genitive the full word takes inside a date, where the month follows in its own
